interpretation.sequence_contract: Upstream sequence identifiers are intended to delimit gait in a single camera-relative direction. That intent is not a new per-sequence visual verification.
interpretation.statistical_unit: Sequences are distinct annotated movement observations. Straightness, distinct sequence IDs, and disjoint frames do not establish independent people or independent random samples.
interpretation.retained_grouping: All windows and sequences of each source remain in one outer fold. Existing inference and aggregation remain grouped at source component.
interpretation.unverified: No new video-level turn annotation, heading validation, verified participant identity, or between-source participant linkage was performed.
interpretation.largest_claim: The primary GAVD paper describes it as the largest online-accessible abnormal-gait video collection annotated by expert clinicians. Attribute this introduction claim rather than certifying a current exhaustive ranking.
interpretation.clinical_label_scope: Clinical annotations describe observed gait patterns; this audit does not verify individual clinical diagnoses.

primary_sources.support: Original paper abstract states 1,874 sequences and clinically annotated video-gait dataset scale.
Section 3.2 introduces the online-accessible clinician-annotated collection; section 3.2.1 describes manual sequence boundaries, at least two gait cycles, and a singular camera-relative direction.

definitions.raw_sequence_overlap: Two different sequence IDs under the same source ID share at least one identical one-based annotation frame. Counts use all raw annotation rows belonging to each population, not only sampled model frames.
definitions.window_overlap: Two distinct retained windows under the same source ID share an exact native frame number among their 24 observations. Frame membership does not assert every joint at that frame is valid.
definitions.future_overlap: Shared exact native frames among offsets 16:24, using zero-based list slicing of the fixed 24 observations.
definitions.views: Literal cam_view strings ordered by raw frame_num. Multiple labels or transitions are annotation findings, not visually adjudicated turns.
definitions.source: YouTube source ID. It is a recording grouping key, not a verified participant ID.
definitions.retained_sequence_rows: Raw annotation rows of the 456 sequence IDs that contribute a common-support window. Some rows in those complete sequences do not contribute to any retained window.

evidence_locations.support: Sequence schema describes a single-direction gait section.
Several sequences can reference one video ID.
Sampling splits by annotation frame gaps, not turning or direction change.
Deduplication uses the full source/native-frame tuple.
Metadata view is copied from the sequence-wide annotation summary.
Errors average windows within sequences, then sequences within sources.
Outer fold assignment is made once per source.
Frozen contract explicitly preserves source dependence and grouped inference.
